title: Egypt *as a stage.*
positioning: Three settings for a CRUSH evening where art, music and a luxury brand meet. CRUSH leads the artists and the creative; NOYA brings the Egypt side to life.

blocks.text: CRUSH brings brands and artists together, Cartier with Gloria Gaynor, IWC with Jamiroquai, in moments people remember. Egypt offers settings few cities can match. NOYA makes them work on the day.

items.caption: Giza
items.title: Dinner facing the Pyramids
items.text: A seated dinner for a brand's top clients, set so the Pyramids are the backdrop at sunset, followed by a live performance from an artist of CRUSH's choosing.

items.caption: Grand Egyptian Museum
items.title: An evening among antiquities
items.text: A reception and dinner at Egypt's newest cultural landmark, with a contemporary artist collaboration in conversation with the collection.

items.caption: El Gouna, Red Sea
items.title: A long table by the sea
items.text: Two days on the Red Sea: arrival by yacht, a long-table dinner on the beach and an intimate performance after dinner.

blocks.label: Where each setting fits
items: Jewellery & watches: an evening among antiquities
Fashion & beauty: the Pyramids or the sea
Automotive: the Giza plateau or the Red Sea coast

left.title: CRUSH leads
items: Artists and talent, including ICONS. by CRUSH

right.title: NOYA delivers in Egypt
items: Venues, locations and permit applications, with local production crews

items.text: VIP airport reception, private transfers and check-in. A welcome dinner for the brand's hosts.
The afternoon at leisure or a private guided visit. In the evening, the dinner and performance.
A late breakfast, an optional morning on the Nile or the Red Sea, then departures.

blocks.text: Venues, access and dates are subject to permits, approvals and availability. NOYA confirms each before anything is presented to a client.

next.label: Next step
next.title: One call to *choose the stage.*
next.text: Choose a setting and a brand. NOYA returns venues, permits, hospitality and logistics, priced for CRUSH to present to its client.
